item.title: Bulletin updated at 07:50 HKT 09/Nov/2023
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
The easterly airstream now affecting the coast of Guangdong will moderate gradually today and tomorrow. It will be brighter over the coast of southern China. An intense northeast monsoon is expected to reach southern China during the weekend. Temperatures will fall progressively and it will be windy over the region early next week. Under the influence of the associated relatively dry continental airstream, the weather will improve over southern China in the middle part of next week. It will be cooler in the morning and at night.
